tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Other conditions as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have carried out a Preventive Health Checkup Services (Cumulative Work Done Value) in any State Govt. / Central Govt. Departments/ Boards/ Govt. Organizations/ Public Sector Units in the last 3 years (FY 2023-24, 2024-2025 & 2025-2026).

The bidder should have executed Preventive Healthcare Checkup Centers with a minimum value of Rs. 5.00 Crores in a single work order for any State Govt/ Central Govt Departments/ Boards/ Govt Organizations/ Public Sectors in the last 3 years (FY 2023-24, 2024-2025 & 2025-2026).

The bidder should have performed Preventive Healthcare Checkups for any State Govt/ Central Govt Departments/ Boards/ Govt Organizations/ Public Sectors in the last 3 years (FY 2023-24, 2024-2025 & 2025-2026).
The bidder should be registered with ESI & EPF as on date of tender submission.
